mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 7.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase corporate wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to higher equity risk premiums and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 7.0, or the average 20d return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 0.1% signals a shift toward tighter monetary policy, which increases discount rates for equity valuations and reduces risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the mean 5d return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in both residential construction permits and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals weakening demand momentum, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60d SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 98.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals deteriorating corporate profitability and reduced equity earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 98.0, or the average 20d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong expansion in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over the past four quarters indicates robust aggregate demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 shows strong growth, or the mean 60d return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment and a decline in unemployment rate signals a strong labor market recovery, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to predict positive 20d SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A stable or declining CPIAUCSL combined with a low federal funds rate indicates disinflationary pressures and accommodative monetary policy, which reduces real interest rates and enhances equity valuation multiples, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of low CPIAUCSL and low FEDFUNDS fails to predict positive 5d SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 99.0, combined with rising residential construction permits, signals strong supply-side momentum and improving business investment, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising INDPRO and HOUST fails to predict positive 60d SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
